info.name: Open Trivia Database Categories Tokens API

params.name: token
params.description: Existing session token. Required when `command=reset`; ignored when `command=request`.

items.docs: Request a new session token or reset an existing one. Session tokens prevent duplicate questions across calls and expire after six hours of inactivity. Use `command=request` to obtain a new token and `command=reset` with the token parameter to recycle an existing token's served-question set.
